entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand I bought.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number? ... Thank you. Now, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just... not good. I find it really hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what you're finding difficult? Sometimes we can walk through a feature and clear things up.
The whole interface is just confusing. I read the user manual and it made no sense. Frankly, I expected more for what I paid. I just want to return it.
I see. Well, your satisfaction is our priority. Let me just pull up your order details to check the return eligibility... Okay, I see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor on December 16th.
According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

Certainly. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address we have on file. Please print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund within 3 to 5 business days.
You're welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
